positive_evidence: Nimbus imports Geth-produced type-0x6 blocks with identical hashes and state roots.
Both consensus clients report non-optimistic heads and execution online.
Both Lighthouse nodes finalized epoch 2 with identical checkpoint roots; sampled execution block hashes and state roots match through block 133. This does not resolve the RPC/gossip blocker.

blocking_issue.summary: Non-blob frame transactions fail blob wrapper validation and cause peer disconnects
blocking_issue.root_cause: tx_desc.nim applies validateBlobTransactionWrapper to TxEip8141 unconditionally; a frame without blobs has no blobsBundle, so validation fails. The ETH broadcast path disconnects peers on txErrorInvalidBlob.
blocking_issue.expected: Accept a valid non-blob frame without requiring a blob wrapper; continue validating wrappers and proofs for transactions that actually carry blobs.
reproduction: Run the attached Kurtosis configuration with ethereum-package.
Wait until Heze epoch 1 and send valid frametx traffic to both clients.
Observe Nimbus eth_sendRawTransaction error.data=txErrorInvalidBlob while Geth accepts the frame.
Observe Nimbus disconnect Geth and both net_peerCount values fall to zero.
The attached transaction is later included by Geth and imported by Nimbus; see both receipts.

onboarding.next_gate: Client-side fix plus RPC, gossip, block import and finality retest before provisioning an observer.
